subject: GatewayAI joint technical demo lab — sponsorship & logistics
messages:
From: Alison Park <alison.park@gatewayai.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: events@gatewayai.com, raj.mehta@gatewayai.com
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal — joint technical demo lab and hands-on sponsorship

Hi Aditya,

Hope you’re well — quick intro, I’m Alison on the partnerships team at GatewayAI. We’re running an invite-only ‘Technical Demo Lab’ (hands-on customer sessions + a small demo booth) in San Francisco the week of Oct 5–8 and think Redwood Inference would be a great partner. Audience is 120+ engineers/ML leads from fintech and retail.

High-level ask: GatewayAI covers venue & basic AV; we’re requesting a co-sponsorship package that includes:
- $30k MDF (to cover booth build, targeted invites, and live workshop materials)
- a 3x3 shared demo footprint and a 90-minute hands-on slot each day
- mutual promotion (email invite to our list + Redwood promo on day-of)

We’ve attached a draft sponsorship termsheet and preliminary floorplan. If this looks interesting I’d love to set a 30-min sync (this week or early next) to align scope, SLAs for lead capture, and sign a simple SOW.

Thanks — Alison
Alison Park
Head of Partnerships, GatewayAI
alison.park@gatewayai.com

Attachments: GatewayAI_Sponsorship_Termsheet_v2.pdf, Lab_Floorplan_v3.png
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Alison Park <alison.park@gatewayai.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — joint technical demo lab and hands-on sponsorship

Alison — thanks for the note and the materials. Redwood is interested. Quick answers up front:
- $30k MDF is in the ballpark; I’ll run numbers with finance but we can probably commit with a short SOW.
- We can staff the hands-on lab (2 engineers + 1 AE per day) but need clarity on power/network and a secure table for laptops (KV cache demos).
- Lead capture: recommend using our shared badge scanner + lead form that posts to HubSpot; we’ll need a data-sharing addendum for leads.

Next steps I suggest:
1) 30-min sync Wed 7/21 10am PT — to confirm agenda and signoff owners (camila, ben, and I).
2) Exchange a brief SOW / mutual action plan that covers MDF milestones, deliverables, and a cancellation clause.
3) Finalize promotional cadence (save-the-date, 2 invites, day-of reminder).

Looping in Camila for comms cadence and Ben for ops + shipping.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Aditya / Camila — I dug into logistics with ops. Quick notes:
- Staffing: 2 field engineers and 1 AE per day is doable. Travel capped at $1,200 per person (flight + hotel) unless leadership signs off.
- Shipping: crate ship to venue; estimate $950 roundtrip. We’ll need lead retrieval hardware (we own badge scanners) and a small locked case for demo GPUs.
- Power/Network: request at least 2 dedicated 110V outlets and a wired ethernet drop per demo station (the floorplan shows shared racks — good to confirm).
- Booth collateral: please confirm if Gateway will print joint co-branded handouts or if Redwood handles printing.

I’ve attached a rough ops checklist (Proposed_Agenda.docx) and put preliminary dates in our ops calendar.

Ben
Ben Carter
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: Proposed_Agenda.docx

Subject: Re: Proposal — joint technical demo lab and hands-on sponsorship

Hi Alison — thanks, this looks promising. A few comms and calendar items from our side:
- Promotion: we can send a co-branded invite to ~20k audience segment (engineers/ML) — recommend two waves: Save-the-date (3 weeks prior) + Final invite (5 days prior).
- Creative: please share logo in SVG and any copy for the invite by Aug 1. We’ll build an event landing page and track registrations.
- Timing: Ben, can you confirm whether the 90-min slot is for 90 continuous minutes or two 45-min deep-dive sessions? If continuous, we’ll rotate two workshop groups.

Alison, can you circulate the SOW + a DocuSign envelope for the MDF terms? Once we have DocuSign + basic SOW we can lock the MDF in our system and book travel.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Partnerships & Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
From: Alison Park <alison.park@gatewayai.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: raj.mehta@gatewayai.com, events@gatewayai.com
Date: 2026-07-22T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — joint technical demo lab and hands-on sponsorship

Great — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Attached is the updated termsheet (GatewayAI_Sponsorship_Termsheet_v2.pdf) and a short mutual action plan (Aditya_Gateway_MutualActionPlan.xlsx).

DocuSign link for a simple SOW is here: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/E-7a9b2c — it covers MDF payment schedule (50% on sign, 50% 30 days before event), co-branding rights, and a basic data-sharing addendum for leads.

Answers to the open items:
- 90-min slot = two 45-min workshop groups back-to-back (we’ll provide two small lab groups).
- Gateway will print co-branded handouts and supply name badges; Redwood to provide joint slide deck and the demo notebooks.
- We’ll confirm power / ethernet in the final floorplan (we’ll send updated floorplan by Aug 5).

If you’re all good I’ll route the DocuSign to Aditya for signature and to your procurement team (cc’d).

Talk soon — Alison
